content_sections.heading: IISc Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: SAP Functional Analyst (HR/SAP): MSc/ BE/ BTech/ MCA/ BSc (Research)/ MSc (Research) OR BSc in Computer Science/ Electronics/ Science OR BCA. SAP Functional Analyst (Student Lifecycle Management - SLCM): MSc/ BE/ BTech/ MCA/ BSc (Research)/ MSc (Research) OR BSc in Computer Science/ Electronics/ Science OR BCA OR 3 year diploma in Engineering and at least 5 years of experience. SAP Functional Analyst (Finance / SAP FICO): MSc/ BE/ BTech/ MCA/ BSc (Research)/ MSc (Research) OR BSc in Computer Science/ Electronics/ Science OR BCA OR 3 year diploma in Engineering and at least 5 years of experience; Experience: 1-2 years of relevant domain and/or SAP functional experience. SAP Functional Analyst (Sourcing & Procurement / SAP MM): MSc/ BE/ BTech/ MCA/ BSc (Research)/ MSc (Research) OR BSc in Computer Science/ Electronics/ Science OR BCA OR 3 year diploma in Engineering and at least 5 years of experience; Experience: 1-2 years of relevant domain and/or SAP functional experience.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IISc Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 06-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IISc to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IISc Software Engineer positions?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Software Engineer (SAP Functional Analyst) posts at IISc is 06-10-2026. Ensure you complete the application process before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Software Engineer role?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies for the Software Engineer (SAP Functional Analyst) positions announced by the Indian Institute of Science (IISc) in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: The eligibility criteria include MSc/ BE/ BTech/ MCA/ BSc (Research)/ MSc (Research), BSc in Computer Science/ Electronics/ Science, BCA, or a 3-year diploma in Engineering with relevant experience. Specific requirements vary slightly per specialization.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for these positions is 30 years. There is no mention of minimum age relaxation in the provided data.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Software Engineer (SAP Functional Analyst) role?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 29,000/- plus HRA per month for the contract period.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive by IISc.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the IISc Software Engineer posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of eligible candidates followed by an online or in-person interview.

faq.question: Q8. What type of job is this recruitment for?
faq.answer: This is a contract-based recruitment for the Software Engineer (SAP Functional Analyst) positions at the Indian Institute of Science.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the Indian Institute of Science located?
faq.answer: The Indian Institute of Science (IISc) is located in Bengaluru, Karnataka, with the pincode 560012.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates with a diploma apply for these positions?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates with a 3-year diploma in Engineering and at least 5 years of experience are eligible for certain SAP Functional Analyst roles, specifically for Student Lifecycle Management, Finance/SAP FICO, and Sourcing & Procurement/SAP MM.
